verdict.rationale: Square provides the core building blocks for a marketplace/platform model: OAuth API to onboard sellers and connect apps to their accounts (square-docs-42, square-supp-oauth-scopes), Payments API with 'Collect Application Fees' for splitting payments between platform and seller (square-docs-37), and a dedicated Payouts API to pay out sellers (square-docs-17). Sandbox testing, webhooks, and idempotency support round out a production-ready integration flow. missing for 10: no explicit multi-party/marketplace guide tying OAuth+application fees+payouts into one documented seller-onboarding flow, and no independent/hands-on marketplace case study confirming real-world payout splits at scale.
